note: Thailand's largest card issuers are the big banks' card arms: Krungthai Card (KTC, of Krungthai Bank), Kasikornbank, Siam Commercial Bank, Bangkok Bank and Krungsri. Kasikornbank's pages answer a bot challenge (2026-10-29), Siam Commercial Bank's rates-and-fees PDF and Krungsri's card pages answer Incapsula's block, and Bangkok Bank's and Krungsri Card's sites didn't answer (no connection, 2026-10-30); none of those is passed or worked around, so only KTC is written. KTC's table of interest, fees and other service charges (effective 1 January 2026, read again 2026-10-30): interest on every card 16% a year, on purchases from the posting date and on cash from the day it's drawn, with up to 45 days free on purchases when the statement is paid in full; the minimum payment 10% of the statement or at least 500 baht; the Visa Infinite, World Mastercard and UnionPay Asia Prestige Diamond take no minimum payment (written as charge cards); the primary card's annual fee 5,000 baht for the Visa Infinite, World Mastercard, KTC X Visa Signature and KTC X World Rewards Mastercard and 10,000 for the UnionPay Asia Prestige Diamond; every other card has no annual fee for a single card (written as the KTC Credit Card this file has held since 2026-10-29; a second card of the same brand costs 500 baht a year, which the game doesn't track); a cash advance 3% of the amount; spending in another currency at most 2.0%, written as 2.0; no late payment fee and no returned-cheque fee (written by leaving them out), but a collection charge of 50 baht for a debt one cycle overdue and 100 for more, which isn't written. Fees and charges are before VAT, whose rate the table doesn't state. The corporate, commercial and government-services cards aren't written. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): AEON Thana Sinsap (Thailand), the largest non-bank card issuer, and the Government Savings Bank (ธนาคารออมสิน), a large state bank that issues credit cards, are added as the second and third issuers, both publishing their terms; ttb's fee PDF (media.ttbbank.com) answers Incapsula's block, Kasikornbank's card page 403, LH Bank's Incapsula, and UOB Thailand's card page 404 (2026-10-30). AEON's credit card interest, fees and charges (in force from 11 December 2568, i.e. 2025, read 2026-10-30): 16% a year on the amount used, from the day the merchant is paid; the minimum payment 10% of the bill, at least 500 baht (the Classic, Gold, Tang Hua Seng, TDP, B-Quik, Giffarine, Club Thailand, M GEN and Olympic cards) or 1,000 baht (the NextGen, Royal Orchid Plus, Big C, Wellness, J-Premier, Rabbit and UnionPay Platinum cards), the whole bill below that; none is stated for the Primo card; a cash withdrawal 2.5% of the amount; up to 52 days free of interest from the statement's closing when paid in full; the primary card's annual fee: Primo and NextGen free; 200 baht for the Classic, Tang Hua Seng, TDP, B-Quik Visa, Giffarine, M GEN Visa and Rabbit Platinum; 500 for the Gold, J-Premier Platinum and Olympic Visa; 1,500 for the UnionPay Platinum and Wellness Platinum; 12,000 for the Royal Orchid Plus World Mastercard; 3,000 for the Royal Orchid Plus Platinum; 1,200 for the Club Thailand; 1,000 for the Big C World Mastercard; 500 for the Big C Platinum Visa; no returned-cheque fee; a currency-conversion charge of at most 2.5%, written as 2.5%. Fees are before VAT, whose rate the page doesn't state. A collection charge of 50 or 100 baht a cycle on an overdue debt above 1,000 baht isn't written; the corporate card isn't. The Government Savings Bank's credit card product disclosure (ข้อมูล ณ กุมภาพันธ์ 2569, i.e. February 2026, read 2026-10-30): its five cards' annual fees for the primary card (Mastercard World Elite 10,000 baht, Mastercard World 3,000, Mastercard Platinum 1,500, Visa Signature (Prestige) 5,000, Visa Platinum (Precious) 1,500), no joining fee; 16% a year on an unsecured card (15% on a card secured against GSB lottery bonds, a condition the game doesn't check); no late fee or other charge for using the limit; a cash withdrawal 3% of the amount; up to 50 days free of interest on the Signature and World Elite and 45 on the Platinum and World; the minimum payment 8% of the statement from January to December 2026, written as 8% (from January 2027 it becomes 10%, at least 1,000 baht, not yet written); a currency-conversion charge of at most 2.5%, written as 2.5%. The limit, 1.5, 3 or 5 times monthly income by income band, is a set of multiples the form doesn't hold and isn't written; nor is the collection charge.
